complete_examples.text: In this section, three numerical examples, including extreme analysis, dynamic reliability analysis and response relationships analysis, are presented to illustrate the extended applications of the proposed models.
Based on these two models, three more extended applications are illustrated, including extrema analysis, dynamic reliability analysis and prediction of response relationship between dynamic indices.
